_comment: Georgia Department of Transportation specification references. Every code and quotation is transcribed from the GDOT documents listed in _sources and verified against them. Nothing here is a Virginia specification renamed.

_sources.mixes: GDOT Special Provision, Section 828 — Hot Mix Asphaltic Concrete Mixtures, dated September 27, 2018. https://www.dot.ga.gov/PartnerSmart/Business/Source/special_provisions/Special%20Provision/SP%20828%20Hot%20Mix%20Asphalt%20Concrete%20Mixes.pdf

_sources.permit: GDOT Regulations for Driveway and Encroachment Control, Chapter 1. https://www.dot.ga.gov/PartnerSmart/permits/Encroachment/Chapter1.pdf

_note: Section 828.2.03.B is titled 'Requirements for Superpave Parking Lot Mixes (NOT FOR STANDARD HIGHWAY/STREET PAVING)'. It is cited here because it is the section GDOT wrote for the work this company does in Georgia — commercial parking facilities — rather than a highway section borrowed to sound authoritative.

nominalSizeRule.quote: The Nominal Maximum Sieve Size is one standard sieve size larger than the first sieve to retain more than ten percent of the aggregate, per AASHTO R35. Mixture types in this section are identified according to Nominal Maximum Sieve Size.
